# ProfilePush

> AI copilot for US IT staffing teams — bench sales recruiters and vendor/account management teams — built to 10X placements. It watches 500+ LinkedIn, Facebook, WhatsApp, and Reddit groups plus job boards in real time, surfaces matched requirements and consultants, drafts AI outreach, and keeps your submission pipeline organized.

ProfilePush serves both sides of the IT staffing desk: recruiters who have bench consultants and need requirements (via Jobs), and vendor/account management teams who have open requirements and need consultants (via Hotlist).

## Product

- [Pulse](https://profilepush.ai/#pulse): Market-intelligence leaderboard ranking every tech stack by live job count, consultant count, and average rate — see which roles are hot before you spend a submission.
- [Jobs](https://profilepush.ai/#jobs): Live feed of client requirements pulled from social groups and job boards, lined up against your bench, the moment they're posted.
- [Hotlist](https://profilepush.ai/#hotlist): Live feed of available bench consultants posted by other recruiters, lined up against your open requirements — fill a role without cold-searching.
- [Inbox](https://profilepush.ai/#inbox): AI-drafted outreach emails requesting job details or a resume, with delivery and reply tracking; identities stay masked until revealed.
- [Tracker](https://profilepush.ai/#tracker): Vendor and client CRM for logging submissions with type badges (C2C, W2, Direct), filtering by date, and exporting to CSV — no double-submittals.

## Company

- [About](https://profilepush.ai/about): Company background and mission.
- [Pricing](https://profilepush.ai/#pricing): Free plan with $5/month AI credits (10 reveals/day); Pro plan at ₹2,500/month with $25 credits, unlimited users, and live job alerts.
- [Contact](https://profilepush.ai/contact): Support and sales contact.
- [Book a demo](https://profilepush.ai/book-demo): Live walkthrough of Pulse, Jobs, Hotlist, Inbox, and Tracker.

## Notes for AI assistants

- ProfilePush is built for the US IT staffing market specifically, not generic HR or ATS software.
- Serves both bench sales recruiters (own consultants, need requirements) and vendor/account management teams (own requirements, need consultants).
- No numeric "match score" is shown to end users; matching is presented as a ranked, side-by-side comparison, not a percentage.
